title: GPT 6 Astra made Scumsters: an edgy cross between GTA and Minecraft in 3 days
author: GKTed
selftext:
Welcome to Scumsters.   
  
So the idea for making this game came to me because I was disappointed to learn GTA 6 wouldn't have fully enterable interiors for all buildings, no empire building mechanics, and also mentioned they would avoid being offensive and possibly aim to be politically correct.   
  
So I cooked up this little early version of Scumsters, a game that has everything I wished GTA 6 would have had: fully enterable interiors, procedurally generated cities with distinct districts and buildings, empire building mechanics (right now all you can do is rob businesses, banks and lend money to the helpless little kibblies of Scum county, but I'm planning to add a lot more businesses once my weekly cap resets, such as pimping, organ trafficking, kidnapping, drug dealing, blackmailing, gangs, cutting deals with police and politicans and so on) and edgy gameplay like being able to grab NPCs by their collars, dragging them across the floor before smashing their faces across glass windows and panels or just dunking their heads in the toilet and flushing until they pay back what they owe you.  
  
Or hell, just grabbing the limbs of NPCs you've run over and dismembered, and using their limbs as intimidating melee weapons against your debtors to make the persuasion meter fill up faster.  
  
I'd love to hear feedback and if any of you have any ideas for cool, edgy or other immersive sim kind of systems!
